name: codex-chess
description: Cyber Chess: a playable 3D browser chess game packaged for the Codex game challenge.

scripts.build:pages: npm run build && rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp -R index.html app.js avatars media pieces_fbx dist/
scripts.desktop:stage: npm run build && node scripts/package-desktop.mjs stage
scripts.package:win: npm run build && node scripts/package-desktop.mjs package
scripts.preflight: npm run build && npm run smoke
